timeZoneHint: Use the same day, repeat schedule and reminder times on every device. Changing this does not move scheduled dates or deadlines.
launchAtLoginHint: After you log in, Taskora starts in the background and stays in the tray without opening a window.
statusBarHint: Keep today’s open tasks in the notification shade and quick-add by typing a title without opening the app.
statusBarFailed: Could not show the status bar notification. Check that Taskora notifications and the Status bar channel are enabled in system settings, then retry.
statusBarPermissionDenied: Notification permission denied. Allow Taskora notifications in system settings, then try again.
reminderReliabilityHint: System and phone-maker battery policies can block reminders. When everything below is OK, reminders arrive on time even with the app closed.
reminderAutostartHint: Can't be detected automatically. On Xiaomi, OPPO, vivo, Huawei and similar phones, reminders only arrive after swiping the app away if auto-start is allowed.
reminderSettingsFailed: Couldn't open this settings page. Please find Taskora in system settings manually.
groupTasksByParent: Group tasks by project/area in time views
groupTasksByParentHint: When on, tasks in Today, Anytime, and Someday cluster under their project or area. Turn off to return to the flat list.
loggingMode: Move completed items to the Logbook
loggingModeHint_IMMEDIATE: Completed and cancelled items leave their list as soon as you check them off.
loggingModeHint_DAILY: Items you complete today stay in their list, crossed out, and move to the Logbook after midnight.
loggingModeHint_MANUAL: Completed items stay in their list, crossed out, until you choose Log Completed or use the button in the Logbook.
loggingModeHint_MANUALShortcut: Completed items stay in their list, crossed out, until you choose Log Completed ({{shortcut}}) or use the button in the Logbook.
exportDescription: Export all your data as a JSON file for backup or migration.
deleteAccountDescription: Permanently delete your account and all data. This cannot be undone.
deleteAccountConfirmDescription: This will permanently delete your account and all data, and cannot be undone. Please enter your password to confirm.
serverSetupSubtitle: Connect to your self-hosted Taskora server
assistantApiKeyHint: Stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM). Leave empty to keep the saved key.
assistantModelIdHint: Model name on the endpoint, e.g. deepseek-chat
assistantThinkingHint: Reasoning models (e.g. deepseek-reasoner, qwen3) think before answering at the selected effort.
shortcutsHint: Click a shortcut, then press the new key combination. Press Esc to cancel. Custom shortcuts are saved on this device only.
shortcutFixedQuickAddEnter: Quick Add: add and close from the title
shortcutFixedQuickAddEscape: Quick Add: discard draft and close
shortcutGlobalNeedsModifier: System-wide shortcuts must include Ctrl, Alt or ⌘
shortcutGlobalRegisterFailed: Couldn't set this shortcut. Another app may be using it.
shortcutTakenByGlobal: This shortcut is used by “Open Quick Add”
shortcut_reviewMarkNext: Mark reviewed and go to next
